_HOW_ONE_ROW_RUNS_THREE_LEVELS: The driver run_m6_own_family_triple.sh runs ONE level per invocation (usage: <L2|L1|L0> [stage|solve|all]). launch_cmd chains L2 -> L1 -> L0 with '&&' so a non-zero level STOPS the chain. The single 2,136 core-min cap is a SINGLE ACCUMULATOR persisted on disk at <run_root>/SOLVE_SPENT_COREMIN.txt across all three invocations (prereg 7.3); an overrun STOPS the campaign and does not get a new budget (rule 12). Per-level ranks inside the driver: L2=4, L1=8, L0=14.
_RANKS_RESERVATION: ranks=14 is the daemon's scheduling reservation = the PEAK leg (L0, the binding constraint). queue_runner.tick() holds unless busy_cores + ranks <= core_fraction(0.9) x ncpu(16) = 14.4, so a 14-rank row launches ONLY when the box is near-idle (the M6-priority core window the supervisor signals the chief to assemble). The daemon over-reserves for the L2/L1 legs (4/8 ranks) inside one launch_cmd, which is conservative (never oversubscribes).
_L505_NO_USER_WRAP: NO `env USER=` wrap. The solver is the STOCK OpenFOAM-v2506 rhoSimpleFoam at the FOAM PLATFORM bin, run inside docker dafoam-idwarp-rot:v1 as -u 1002:1002 -- USER-independent. L-505 is a host user-space (FOAM_USER_APPBIN) trap and does not apply to a docker-isolated stock binary; adding the wrap would be cargo-cult (driver header; L-505 distinction).
